subject: SAC-B6b observed touched-dimension selection pressure
intent: Replace the B6 pre-collision projection upper-bound proxy with explicit post-hash unique touched-dimension diagnostics before considering any adaptive Active rule.

instrumentationBoundary.sparsePath: Encoder.EncodeWithStats is explicit opt-in; normal Encode semantics and per-feature instrumentation cost remain unchanged.
instrumentationBoundary.providerPath: B2 family-local and global-residual stats are internal evaluation instrumentation and are not added to the provider-neutral response contract.
stopLines: path saturation != sufficient proof of retrieval failure

fixture.source: existing B6 capacityEvalItems anchor with B1 family normalization and B2 equal-local half-global residual policy

findings: The B6 pre-collision total-active proxy 512/576≈0.889 substantially overstates the oversized global-residual path, whose observed winner share is 256/574≈0.446.
The oversized graph, provenance, and grouping local paths are fully saturated at selected/touched=1.0, while text remains selective at about 0.131.
Grouping already reaches 1.0 in the large profile where the existing B6 fixture still preserves desired ordering, so saturation of one path alone is not a sufficient failure criterion.

Global-residual collision fraction falls monotonically from 0.140625 to about 0.00347 as dimensions grow, while observed winner share rises from about 0.0323 to about 0.446. The selection-pressure loss therefore cannot be attributed to hash collision growth.

Merged selected dimensions are below the configured total Active because family-local and global-residual winners overlap; in the oversized fixture the merged signature has 256 dimensions despite a configured total budget of 512.

independentReconstruction.method: Independent deterministic reconstruction of Go byte-wise feature hashing, splitmix64 projection, SUI-shaped feature extraction, family grouping, B1 family normalization, and B2 local/global selection.
independentReconstruction.result: matched the expected touched/selected counts encoded in the new Go regression fixtures
independentReconstruction.limitation: This is not an exact repository Go test run and does not replace Go 1.25 verification.
